Read and normalize BIDS event files for MEDuSA HRF, deconvolution, and alignment workflows

Source: R/fmriprep_bids.R
read_bids_events.Rd

Reads one or more BIDS *_events.tsv files (or normalizes in-memory BIDS data.frames) into MEDuSA's event table contract: finite numeric onset and non-negative duration (in seconds), non-empty condition labels (mapped by default from BIDS trial_type), run-matched run labels in bold run order, and unique within-run trial indices. Standard BIDS missing tokens ("n/a") are parsed automatically without coercing numeric behavioral columns to character.

Usage

read_bids_events(
  events,
  bold = NULL,
  run_names = NULL,
  condition_col = "trial_type",
  condition_map = NULL,
  default_condition = NULL,
  exclude_conditions = NULL,
  na_duration = 0,
  drop_missing_onset = FALSE,
  drop_missing_condition = FALSE,
  time_shift = 0,
  trial_col = "trial",
  run_col = "run",
  sort_by_onset = FALSE,
  na_strings = c("n/a", "N/A", "NA", ".", "NaN", ""),
  output = c("data.frame", "list")
)

Arguments

events

Character vector of BIDS event file paths (.tsv, .tsv.gz, .csv, .csv.gz), a single data.frame, or a list of per-run data.frames.

bold

Optional "medusa_nifti_ts" object, named list of run BOLD matrices, single BOLD matrix, or character vector of target run names used to validate BIDS sub-/ses-/task- entities and order event runs identically to BOLD runs.

run_names

Optional explicit character vector of unique run names when bold is NULL.

condition_col

Column name in the BIDS event table supplying condition labels when condition is not already present (or when different from "condition"). Default "trial_type".

condition_map

Optional named character vector recoding raw condition values (e.g., c(win_fb = "feedback", loss_fb = "feedback")). Unmatched condition labels are preserved unchanged.

default_condition

Optional scalar string assigned to condition only when neither "condition" nor condition_col exists in a single-condition BIDS event table (e.g., "event").

exclude_conditions

Optional character vector of raw condition labels (prior to condition_map) to exclude from the returned table.

na_duration

Replacement duration (in seconds, >= 0) used when duration is missing or "n/a" (default 0 for impulse events). Set NULL to error on missing durations.

drop_missing_onset

Logical; if TRUE, rows with missing or non-finite onset are dropped instead of raising an error. Default FALSE.

drop_missing_condition

Logical; if TRUE, rows with missing or empty condition labels are dropped instead of raising an error. Default FALSE.

time_shift

Numeric scalar or run-ordered numeric vector added to onset (in seconds; default 0).

trial_col

Name of the within-run unique trial index column populated when not already present in events. Default "trial".

run_col

Name of the run identifier column populated on returned event tables. Default "run".

sort_by_onset

Logical; if TRUE, sorts events chronologically by onset within each run while recording original 1-based file row numbers in bids_event_row. Default FALSE preserves exact file row order for 1-to-1 behavioral joins.

na_strings

Character vector of missing-value tokens passed to data.table::fread. Default c("n/a", "N/A", "NA", ".", "NaN", "").

output

Return container format: "data.frame" (default; single combined multi-run data.frame ready to pass directly to estimate_crossrun_hrf, decon_epoch_regression, and align_medusa_ts) or "list" (run-named list of per-run data.frames).

Value

Either a combined multi-run data.frame (output = "data.frame") or a run-named list of data.frames (output = "list").

See also

read_fmriprep_confounds, read_fmriprep_subject, read_nifti_ts, estimate_crossrun_hrf, decon_epoch_regression

Examples

f1 <- tempfile("sub-01_task-mid_run-01_", fileext = "_events.tsv")
f2 <- tempfile("sub-01_task-mid_run-02_", fileext = "_events.tsv")
writeLines(c(
  "onset\tduration\ttrial_type\tresponse_time\trpe",
  "2.0\t0.5\tcue\tn/a\tn/a",
  "6.0\t0.8\tfeedback\t0.52\t0.75"
), f1)
writeLines(c(
  "onset\tduration\ttrial_type\tresponse_time\trpe",
  "3.0\t0.5\tcue\tn/a\tn/a",
  "7.5\tn/a\tfeedback\t0.61\t-0.40"
), f2)

ev <- read_bids_events(c(f1, f2))
unlink(c(f1, f2))
